notes: ESI 2 (1984): 87-88 has no pool, pit or grave of this site. The text mentions only 'a courtyard with a room and some installations' (p. 87), not described further. The plan (p. 87, 'el-Qasr, the fortress') draws an unlabelled stone-ringed circular feature in the lower left of the courtyard; the publication does not say what it is, so it is not coded. The plan has no identifiable north arrow and the unit's point cannot be placed on it. The report's only date is for the fort as a whole (5th-6th centuries CE). No passage on burials; silence is not an absence statement.
